app.title: Prasat
app.subtitle: Raise the temple towers
app.tagline: Drop each carved stone right on the one below and raise towers like Angkor's, across 150 levels and an endless climb.

home.how1: A stone slides over the tower. Tap anywhere to drop it.
home.how2: Whatever hangs over the stone below is cut off, so the next stone is smaller. Miss completely and the tower is done.
home.how3: Drop it dead on for a perfect fit; three in a row and the stone grows back a little.

angkor.name: Angkor Wat
angkor.blurb: Sandstone carved with lotus flowers, rising over the jungle.

bayon.name: Bayon
bayon.blurb: Towers of smiling stone faces, looking out every way.

banteaysrei.name: Banteay Srei
banteaysrei.blurb: Pink stone, carved as finely as lace. Wind sometimes.

kohker.name: Koh Ker
kohker.blurb: A great stepped pyramid in the far north.

preahvihear.name: Preah Vihear
preahvihear.blurb: On the edge of a cliff, high in the clouds and the wind.

palace.name: Royal Palace
palace.blurb: White and gold by night: the last and tallest spires.

briefing.wind: The wind makes stones speed up and slow down

tips.perfect: Watch the edges line up, and tap. Perfect drops in a row grow the stone back.
tips.wind: Wind: the stone speeds up and slows down. Time your tap.
tips.tall: A tall tower: stay calm, and keep the stone wide.

game.noWebgl: This device can't show the 3D temple (WebGL is off or not supported).

hints.tap: Tap anywhere to drop the stone onto the tower.
hints.cut: Whatever hangs over the edge is cut off.
hints.streak: Three perfect drops in a row grow the stone back.

result.starsHint: Keep more of the stone for more stars.

intro.0: Sophal. A carver's first lesson: a tower is only as good as each stone.
intro.1: So I set each one right on top of the last?
intro.2: Exactly. Whatever overhangs, we cut away. Keep your stones wide.

intro.0: Master, all these stone faces are smiling at me.
intro.1: They smile at careful hands. Let's give them a tall tower.

intro.0: Banteay Srei: the finest carving in the land, in pink stone.
intro.1: And the wind keeps pushing my stones about!
intro.2: Then watch the wind as well as the stone. Patience.

intro.0: Koh Ker! It looks like a great staircase to the sky.
intro.1: Seven tiers, built a thousand years ago. Now it's your turn.
intro.2: A thousand years? No pressure, then.

intro.0: Preah Vihear stands at the edge of the cliff. The wind is strong up here.
intro.1: I can see the whole plain from here!
intro.2: Then don't look down. Look at your stone.

intro.0: The Royal Palace, Master? Me, building spires here?
intro.1: Who else? You've raised towers at every great temple.
intro.2: Then tonight, I'll build the tallest of all.

outro.0: Look at that spire in the moonlight. You're a master carver now, Sophal.
outro.1: I learned it one stone at a time, Master.
outro.2: That's the only way. Now, how high can you go with no end at all?
